feeds.title: CrystalandComp.com Blog
feeds.description: I am Crystal VanTassel-Lopez, a Dallas mom blogger with six boys at home {including twins} and I love to share my best ideas and successes with you. This website is all about resources and solutions for moms. We homeschool, meal plan, create easy recipes, share educational activities for kids, and more.

feeds.title: Carrie Elle
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Carrie. I'm a Dallas-based writer, creator, and planner-maker. On this blog you'll find tons of free printables, planning help and inspiration, and family travel destinations and tips. Explore articles, guides, and DIY manuals to get yourself started.

feeds.title: Our Family Lifestyle
feeds.description: Our Family Lifestyle is a Dallas Mom Blog featuring stories that focus on parenting, how-to, and family travel from a mom's perspective. Hi, I'm Staci Salazar. From general lifestyle applications to family travel, to everyday routines, it's all about finding simplicity in the journey of life.

feeds.title: Giggles Galore
feeds.description: Giggles Galore focuses on making the ordinary extraordinary one creative idea at a time. Here you will find holiday crafts, DIY projects, recipes, and party tips. Welcome, I'm Mariah, the creative mind behind Giggles Galore. I'm an event stylist, creative consultant, blogger, social butterfly, and multi-tasking mom.

feeds.title: Julie Measures
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Julie. Julie Measures is a personal blog focusing on my adventures in knitting, crocheting, crafts, food, my kids, and living in Dallas. And I like to measure life in dozens of cookies baked, skeins of yarn knit, or miles traveled. I always want the projects and experiences I share to feel like something you can accomplish.

feeds.title: Grocery Shop For Free
feeds.description: Dian is a mom of four grown children, Nana to 6 beautiful grands, wife to an amazing husband, social influencer, and blogger. I love all things gardening, saving money, tips & tricks to make life easier, ANY cool new gadget, and feeding my Reality TV addiction. Learn how to live better on less, how to save money at grocery and department stores, make money from home, and use all of it to help your family.

feeds.title: The Wiegands Blog
feeds.description: Casey Wiegand of The Wiegand's is a Lifestyle Blog about Family, Health, Intentions, and Whimsical Moments. I'm Casey Wiegand, a mama, wife, artist, creative, and dreamer. Read my perspective on life, faith, kids, marriage, and loss... with touches of art, creative inspiration, fashion, projects & things I love I love to share my life through this little blog.

feeds.title: Digital Mom Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about technology, parenting, mom life, and lots of funny memes. Whether you are a mom looking to read the Woahs of parenting, want to be in the know about the latest in mom technology, watch a review of a cool gadget, impress your kids with Minecraft facts, learn about sleep training toddlers with a kids alarm clock or just enjoy fun geekery links - this is a website that has it. We talk tech, laugh at funny memes and discuss all things about mom life.

feeds.title: Trendy Mom Reviews
feeds.description: Get the latest updates and trends from Dallas Mom Blog and Fort Worth Mom Blogger. Trendy Mom Reviews connects with Dallas area moms by sharing recipes, activities, tips, and travel ideas. We have several moms of different ages who work with our team throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth metro. Our focus is always to find the trendiest content for our readers.

feeds.title: My Traveling Roads
feeds.description: Welcome, I'm Kim Croisant, Owner/Content Creator of My Traveling Roads, Mom to her grandson since his birth in 2009. This blog is a family travel blog that offers the best road trips through Texas & beyond. Plus family fun & adventures, and self-care tips. Check recent posts to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: The Java Mama
feeds.description: The Java Mama is a Lifestyle Blog by Becky Branch that narrates her and her family's daily lives. Becky is a wife, mom, Christian, photographer, & coffee junkie and has been blogging for over 11 years. She love share her DIY work as well as her personal life with people and inspire them to do the same.

feeds.title: Dian Farmer
feeds.description: Dian, an enthusiastic gardener, invites you to join her on her journey to cultivate food for her family and others. Through this blog, she shares her passion for helping people and imparts the gardening tips, tricks, and knowledge she's gleaned through her own experiences and continuous learning.

feeds.title: Your Tween & You Blog
feeds.description: Learn fresh strategies and skills to build mutual trust and respect with your adolescent through our blog and workshops. Your Tween & You empowers and supports you as your child transforms from a child to an adult. We have helped parents just like you learn exceptional parenting skills that result in launching extraordinary adults.

feeds.title: Lauren Kay Sims Blog
feeds.description: Lauren is a Dallas fashion blogger who believes that inner beauty and refined style are the building blocks to a radiant life. You will find trendy clothing and apparel along with other accessories recommended by her here. Browse more about her thoughts on incorporating fashion, fitness, health, beauty, faith, and more in her blog.

feeds.title: So Heather
feeds.description: Personal Style Blog of Heather Anderson. It allows her to share her sense of style one outfit at a time with many people. Access her Videos and tutorials on Fashion, beauty, and other essentials. Heather Anderson of So Heather is a Dallas-based lifestyle influencer who believes in empowering women to look and feel confident no matter their age.

feeds.title: Hustle Mom Repeat
feeds.description: My name is Dawn. My blog mainly focuses on lifestyle content, information on products, travel, recipes, entertainment, and more which I learned from life lessons, and that brought blessings in many ways. Stay connected with Hustle Mom Repeat and get the latest updates.

feeds.title: Finding Debra
feeds.description: Finding Debra a lifestyle and travel blog following Debra Muccio, one adventure at a time! Debra Muccio is a wife and mother living in the Dallas/Ft Worth area. You'll find everything from family travel and entertainment to recipes. Check out recent posts for interesting articles on Kids, Toys, Shopping and more.

feeds.title: My Crazy Savings
feeds.description: My Crazy Savings is a blog by Courtney Solstad who loves to talk about family-friendly events and deals in Dallas. You can save on almost everything with proper research. Check out her posts to get the latest updates, details of crazy deals, sales, and tips for saving.

feeds.title: Real & Quirky
feeds.description: Get all the latest real and quirky posts on recipes, travel, birth stories, and homeschooling. Hey! I'm Jenn, a busy mom of 5 kiddos in Fort Worth, Texas. We are a homeschooling family, I work part-time, blog, and volunteer with a local non-profit organization, and try to juggle it all.

feeds.title: Bishop & Holland
feeds.description: Bishop & Holland is a one-stop shop for lifestyle, fashion and all things chic. We started this blog to share our adventures and fun. We are a mom, daughter & daughter-in-law, trio who share a common bond in the things we love: traveling, enjoying good food and wine, styles of all kinds, and our homes & families.

feeds.title: Fit Dallas Mom Blog
feeds.description: Fit Dallas Mom follows the story of Stephanie Lopez, a mom of three trying to keep herself healthy and fit while focused on her family. Stay updated on the daily adventures that she has with her family.

feeds.title: Dani Austin Blog
feeds.description: Dani Austin talks about her favorite lifestyle brands, upcoming sales in her store and other fashion tips and ideas. Dani Austin is a fashionista, wife, mom of 2, and a blogger sharing updates on health and wellness, beauty, her family and personal life.

feeds.title: Vandi Fair
feeds.description: Find the latest updates on the Dallas lifestyle, inspirational wedding ideas, fashionable outfits for traveling, colorful summer outfits and cozy holiday looks on our blog. Vandi Fair is a fashion blog by me, Lauren, a mama, fashion enthusiast, and color addict. I'm here to help YOU live your most COLORFUL life and find joy and fun in fashion, mamahood, travel, home decor, and everyday life.

feeds.title: Doing Life with Bridgette Blog
feeds.description: Bridgette Reed is a Mom Blogger who enjoys sharing her Family adventures, Vlogs, and Social Media to empower women to be their best selves while taking care of their homes. Bridgette helps women birth their businesses God's way using faith as our foundation and grace as our standard.

feeds.title: Kaywanda Lamb Blog
feeds.description: Kaywanda Lamb, author, speaker, and blogger known as The Winning Single Mom, empowers single mothers on their parenting journey. Through coaching and resources, she guides moms to raise exceptional children while transforming their own lives. Her articles cover single parenting, date ideas, family savings, and lifestyle tips, offering practical wisdom and encouragement to fellow single parents.

feeds.title: Dallas Single Mom Blog
feeds.description: Dallas Single Parents {Dallas Single Mom} by Teia Collier is the premier Dallas-based lifestyle guide and resource service whose purpose is to inspire, encourage and support single parents in living their best lives now. Our latest blog articles explore Car news, Local issues, Travel and more.

feeds.title: Everyday Best
feeds.description: Shannon Schmid writes in Everyday Best about everything that makes life a little bit easier and a little bit better. Find the best simple recipes, life hacks, simple crafts, and more on EverydayBest.com. Shannon is a former Television Producer that 'retired' to focus on her family and then a growing business.
